text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having broken free from her negative 
feelings toward Duramente, Kitasan Black 
trained diligently with her eyes set on 
winning the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when disheartened, Kitasan Black 
possesses an unwavering core— Cheval Grand 
wanted to see that strength for herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She personally asked to watch the Kikuka 
Sho. In Kyoto, she burned the image of 
Kitasan Black's victory into her memory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from the wildly exciting 
Kikuka Sho, Cheval Grand opens up about 
what's in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Kitasan Black was similar to herself; she 
had never stood out and had harbored 
feelings of inferiority, yet she faced her 
weaknesses and overcame them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—She wanted to believe that she, too, 
possessed a strength unique to her own 
self.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand began looking beyond her 
immediate surroundings. Setting her sights 
on future showdowns with Kitasan Black, 
she resolved to devote herself to 
training.
